focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of the engraved text on the metal casing (dependent on OVD localization).
Structural validity of the hinge mechanism connecting the lens and case.
Optical clarity and geometric perfection of the convex lens.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the metal plate. AI generators often struggle with small, engraved text on reflective surfaces. Verify if the characters are distinct and meaningful (e.g., '10x', 'Made in Germany') or if they devolve into abstract shapes. Also, inspect the hinge screw for realistic mechanical detail (slots/threads) versus a smooth, generated blob. Ensure the open_vocabulary_detector successfully isolates the text region before the image_text_auditor attempts OCR.
image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a folding jeweler's loupe. The device features a black circular lens housing on the left and a polished silver metal protective casing on the right, connected by a hinge mechanism. The metal casing has engraved text indicating magnification specifications (partially legible as '10x' or similar). The background is a plain, out-of-focus white.
